verification.notes: Nick Moody phone self-test, 2026-10-04. Epic copy (GameHub id 156707). physx component 1.0.1 is required: without it the real game reported a General protection fault. Launch ShippingPC-BmGame.exe via bm_run.bat (same as 0run.bat) from D: inside the virtual desktop, not the Epic starter Batman.exe. BmEngine.ini: AmbientOcclusion, FogVolumes, DepthOfField, MotionBlur, and Distortion set to False; ResX/ResY 1280x720. FEX translation Custom, original values plus Vector TSO, Memcpy TSO, and Half Barrier turned on. Env: DXVK_LOG_PATH=D: and DXVK_LOG_LEVEL=info (was warn). Container graphics stack recorded the same day, when LEGO Batman 3 was launched from this container: Proton 10.0-arm64x-2, DXVK 2.4.1-async, Turnip v26.1.0_b8. Menu and opening ran at 55–60 FPS. ProtonDB leads (newer Proton general-protection faults, Proton 8, PhysX effects off, -nolauncher) were not tried. GameHub has proton9.0-arm64x-3 installed; it was not the tested container.
known_issues: Blocky/checkerboard shading on the menu still present
Crashed once after about 4 minutes: Assertion failed: appUncompressMemory(...) UnAsyncWork.cpp line 170. Vector TSO, Memcpy TSO, and Half Barrier were turned on in response; not yet confirmed fixed
Epic starter Binaries\Batman.exe exits in about 4 seconds with code 0 (opens BmLauncher.exe and exits). GameHub then closes the container. The library tile still does this
Wide static band across the screen in gameplay before the BmEngine.ini effects were turned off; gameplay not re-checked after that change
FEX preset Compatible: 14 FPS, CPU 100%, stuttering audio. Too slow. Not the applied preset
